title: Has anyone dreamed about a daycare center?
content: I don’t have many dreams but I remember very few of them when I do have them and one i remember the most vividly is this daycare center but it looks like the circus from the amazing digital circus. I had this dream before I watched it and was very surprised when I saw it and watched it in the show. In my dream I don’t know what I am but I’m small, not a child, I think too we and know too many thinks then a child of that size, and I’m kidnapped by someone, I don’t know who but I know I’m in danger and try to find different ways to leave but end up getting caught. But Everytime I get caught I only see black and I’m In a room with bright rainbow colored mats, walls, toys, cribs. Clearly a daycare. I’m just wondering if this is a weird thing my brain is doing or if anyone else has had a dream about this daycare center too. The lights are always off, it’s always dark, and the windows are always closed with curtains so there’s very little light but just enough to be able to see colors and things just not clearly
